newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's reports another good year for CUB.
newsitem.headline: Foster's reports another good year for CUB.

text.p: Australia's Foster's Brewing Group Ltd on Thursday said its earnings powerhouse, Carlton and United Breweries (CUB), had a good year in 1996/97 (July/June).
Foster's chairman John Ralph, speaking after a meeting of shareholders in Melbourne, told reporters Foster's international sales were also growing "very nicely".
Ralph declined to comment about Foster's earnings for year ended June 30, but highlighted CUB's performance.
"CUB has had a very good year," he said.
CUB is Foster's domestic brewer with over 50 percent of the Australian beer market.
Foster's is due to announce 1996/97 earnings in August.
It has said it expects to report a rise in earnings before interest and tax for the year.
On Thursday morning, a meeting about 250 shareholders voted to approve the company's plan to buy-back 254.5 million shares for A$625 million from Japan's Asahi Breweries Ltd.
